PersonalizationStatusResponse.description:
Current personalization state for the authenticated user.

Fields
------
training_state:
    ``"in_progress"``  – a training run is QUEUED or RUNNING (Req 5.6).
    ``"completed"``    – the most recent run completed (ACCEPTED/REJECTED/FAILED).
    ``"none"``         – no training run exists for this user yet.
adapter_active:
    Whether the user has an active adapter applied to recognition.
last_run_outcome:
    ``"accepted"``  – the most recent run was accepted (adapter is live).
    ``"rejected"``  – the most recent run was rejected; prior config retained (Req 5.7).
    ``"failed"``    – the most recent run failed; prior config retained (Req 5.7).
    ``None``        – no run has completed yet (or no run exists).
reject_reason:
    If ``last_run_outcome`` is ``"rejected"`` or ``"failed"``, the recorded
    reason string; otherwise ``None``.
notification:
    A human-readable message describing the current state (may be ``None``
    when no training has been run).
unused_training_pairs:
    Number of labeled examples (corrections + calibration samples) not yet
    consumed by a completed training run — the count that drives the
    training trigger (Req 5.1).
training_trigger_threshold:
    How many unused pairs are required before adapter training is queued.
max_training_epochs:
    Upper bound for epochs in one background training run.
PersonalizationStatusResponse.title: PersonalizationStatusResponse

post.description:
Create a new account, establish a session, and set the session cookie.

Rejects a duplicate username with ``409`` (without disclosing other data).
On success the new user is committed, a bearer token is issued, and the
``session`` cookie is set so subsequent same-origin requests authenticate
automatically.

Creates a new calibration session presenting between 3 and 10 English prompt sentences, each between 1 and 200 characters long (Req 9.2). Calibration is entirely optional — the system functions without it (Req 9.1). Requires authentication. Returns 503 when the calibration capability is unavailable (Req 11.6).

Submit a handwriting image for a specific prompt in the calibration session. The image must be non-empty, ≤10 MB, decodable as PNG/JPEG, and contain a detectable handwriting region (Req 9.3, 9.4). On success a Training_Pair with origin=calibration is stored in the same store as correction pairs (Req 9.5). Requires authentication.
